title: Check that brackets are balanced and correctly nested
storyTitle: Every compartment closed with its own lid
summary: Check a packing robot's log of opened and closed compartments, using a stack to track which one must close next.
goal: Decide whether every compartment was closed with its own lid, in order

examples.label: Nested and correct
examples.explanation: Every lid fits the compartment opened most recently, and nothing is left open.

examples.label: Crossed lids
examples.explanation: A square lid arrives while the round compartment is still the most recent open one.

examples.label: Left open
examples.explanation: One round compartment is never closed.

examples.label: Closed too early
examples.explanation: The last lid arrives when no compartment is open.

examples.label: Empty log
examples.explanation: Nothing was opened, so nothing can be wrong.

ladder.name: Delete matching pairs
ladder.idea: Repeatedly delete adjacent matching pairs such as `()`, `[]` and `{}` until none are left. The log is correct if nothing remains.

ladder.name: Stack of open compartments
ladder.idea: Push every opening symbol. Each closing symbol must match the symbol on top of the stack, which is then popped. At the end the stack must be empty.
ladder.insight: Every pair you delete is the most recently opened compartment. A stack keeps exactly the compartments still open, newest on top, so one pass is enough.

approaches.name: Stack of open compartments
approaches.summary: Push every opening; each lid must match the compartment on top of the stack.

transfer.problem: A text editor must check that formatting tags such as … and … are properly nested, as in hi.
transfer.explanation: The most recently opened tag must close first, which is last in, first out. Push opening tags and compare each closing tag with the top.

selfCheck: Returns False when a lid arrives and nothing is open.
Compares each closing symbol with the most recent unmatched opening symbol, not with any open one.
Returns False when compartments are still open at the end.
Treats an empty log as correct.
